content.text: I need to price the example plan with a 15% discount to show the impact. Let me calculate that for you.

For the requested 15% discount (1500 bps), revenue declines from 51,000 cents to 43,350 cents, a change of -7,650 cents [E1]. Margin falls from 31,000 cents to 23,350 cents (-7,650 cents), and margin percentage drops from 60.78% to 53.86% (-692 bps) [E1]. **Approval authority:** This pricing decision requires sign-off from the VP of Sales or Chief Revenue Officer, as it materially impacts margin and revenue per tenant-month.
